cases.question: How do I import a character?
cases.required: Open **ADD** → **IMPORT MODEL...** and select the rigged GLB or FBX.

cases.question: How do I import a rigged model?
cases.required: Open **ADD** → **IMPORT MODEL...** and select the rigged GLB or FBX.

cases.question: How do I load an NPC model?
cases.required: Open **ADD** → **IMPORT MODEL...** and select the rigged GLB or FBX.

cases.question: How do I add animation FBX?
cases.required: In the Character import review, click **ADD ANIMATION FBX**.

cases.question: How do I import external animations?
cases.required: In the Character import review, click **ADD ANIMATION FBX**.

cases.question: How do I retarget an animation during character import?
cases.required: In the Character import review, click **ADD ANIMATION FBX**.

cases.question: How do I assign gameplay actions to character clips?
cases.required: Select the desired take from **Animation clip**, not **REFERENCE POSE**.

cases.question: How do I map animation clips to Idle and Walk?
cases.required: Select the desired take from **Animation clip**, not **REFERENCE POSE**.

cases.question: How do I configure an NPC?
cases.required: Select the actor in **Scene Hierarchy** and expand **CHARACTER** in the Inspector.

cases.question: How do I set up an NPC?
cases.required: Select the actor in **Scene Hierarchy** and expand **CHARACTER** in the Inspector.

cases.question: How do I make my NPC wander?
cases.required: Expand **CHARACTER** in the selected NPC's Inspector.

cases.question: How do I enable wandering?
cases.required: Expand **CHARACTER** in the selected NPC's Inspector.

cases.question: How do I create a patrol route?
cases.required: Select the Character and expand **PATROL** in its Inspector.

cases.question: How do I make an NPC patrol?
cases.required: Select the Character and expand **PATROL** in its Inspector.

cases.question: How do I save a character prefab?
cases.required: Select the configured Character in the scene hierarchy.

cases.question: How do I create an NPC prefab?
cases.required: Select the configured Character in the scene hierarchy.

cases.question: How do I attach an Action?
cases.required: Select the object that should own the behaviour and expand **ACTION** in the Inspector.

cases.question: How do I add a stock action to an object?
cases.required: Select the object that should own the behaviour and expand **ACTION** in the Inspector.

cases.question: How do I attach an entity script?
cases.required: Select the object that should own the behaviour and expand **SCRIPT** in the Inspector.

cases.question: How do I add a Lua script to an object?
cases.required: Select the object that should own the behaviour and expand **SCRIPT** in the Inspector.

cases.question: How do I add a global script?
cases.required: Save the active level, then expand **GLOBAL SCRIPT** in the Inspector.

cases.question: How do I attach a level-wide script?
cases.required: Save the active level, then expand **GLOBAL SCRIPT** in the Inspector.

cases.question: How do I set up a sliding door?
cases.required: Select the object and expand **ACTION**.

cases.question: How do I make an interactive door?
cases.required: Select the object and expand **ACTION**.

cases.question: How do I wire a switch to a door?
cases.required: On the door's Sliding Door Action, disable **Direct Interaction** if the switch should be the control.

cases.question: How do I create an interaction switch?
cases.required: On the door's Sliding Door Action, disable **Direct Interaction** if the switch should be the control.

cases.question: How do I create a trigger zone?
cases.required: Select the zone object; in **ACTION**, choose **Player Trigger Zone** and click **ADD**.

cases.question: How do I add a player trigger zone?
cases.required: Select the zone object; in **ACTION**, choose **Player Trigger Zone** and click **ADD**.

cases.question: How do I set up a proximity pickup?
cases.required: Select the object; in **ACTION**, choose **Proximity Pickup** and click **ADD**.

cases.question: How do I create a pickup?
cases.required: Select the object; in **ACTION**, choose **Proximity Pickup** and click **ADD**.

cases.question: How do I set up an activation relay?
cases.required: Select the relay object; attach **Activation Relay** from **ACTION** using **ADD**.

cases.question: How do I add a relay?
cases.required: Select the relay object; attach **Activation Relay** from **ACTION** using **ADD**.

cases.question: How do I set up a Play Sound Action?
cases.required: Attach **Play Sound** to the intended owner through **ACTION** → **ADD**.

cases.question: How do I trigger a sound action?
cases.required: Attach **Play Sound** to the intended owner through **ACTION** → **ADD**.

cases.question: How do I edit a projectile spawn point?
cases.required: Select **Player Start**, open **STARTING EQUIPMENT** → **WEAPON FIRING**, and choose **Weapon hand**.

cases.question: How do I create a launch socket?
cases.required: Select **Player Start**, open **STARTING EQUIPMENT** → **WEAPON FIRING**, and choose **Weapon hand**.

cases.question: How do I set fire time in animation?
cases.required: Select Player Start and open **STARTING EQUIPMENT** → **WEAPON FIRING**. Choose the intended **Weapon hand** and **Launch on** action.

cases.question: My arrow launches too early
cases.required: Select Player Start and open **STARTING EQUIPMENT** → **WEAPON FIRING**. Choose the intended **Weapon hand** and **Launch on** action.

cases.question: How do I configure hitscan?
cases.required: Open **STARTING EQUIPMENT** → **WEAPON FIRING** on Player Start and choose **Weapon hand** and **Launch on**.

cases.question: How do I set up an instant ray weapon?
cases.required: Open **STARTING EQUIPMENT** → **WEAPON FIRING** on Player Start and choose **Weapon hand** and **Launch on**.

cases.question: How do I set Surface Type?
cases.required: **SURFACE TYPE**

cases.question: How do I change an impact surface?
cases.required: **SURFACE TYPE**
